subject: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate check-in
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Rivera <alice.rivera@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate check-in

Hi Alice — great to chat today. Quick recap and next steps from our call: 

- Deployment & usage: you confirmed integration with the ingestion pipeline is live for summarization and triage; expected monthly active users ~120 and average session length ~1.4k tokens.
- Current pilot burn: ~250k tokens/week (see attached pilot_usage_report.csv).
- Target production scale: planning for ~1.8M–2.5M tokens/month in Q3 if initial tests go well.
- Cost/price sensitivity: you mentioned an internal target of roughly $800/1M tokens (budget-constrained). You also indicated procurement prefers to see a 30–60 day runway before committing to reserved capacity.

Requested next steps:
1) Can you confirm the expected steady-state monthly token volume range (low/expected/high)? We’ll use that to prepare unit economics and a pricing proposal.
2) You asked about additional free credits while procurement completes the PO — please confirm how many extra tokens (or weeks) would keep you unblocked. Our standard pilot credit top-up is 200k tokens; for larger asks we need manager approval.
3) If you share the procurement timeline/PO cadence, we can align an extension and a short-term rate to bridge to a contract.

I’ve attached the usage report from the last 3 weeks and a one-pager on our pricing bands. I’ll loop Rishi for credit approval if you confirm the extension amount. Happy to schedule a 20-min sync to finalize.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0149

Attachment: pilot_usage_report.csv (summary of daily token burn for last 21 days)

From: Alice Rivera <alice.rivera@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate check-in

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Steady-state volume (expected): low 1.8M / expected 2.1M / high 2.6M tokens per month. Our data science team thinks early usage may spike a bit during onboarding.
- Current burn rate aligns with your report (~250k/week).
- Procurement timeline: procurement needs ~2 weeks to issue a PO once finance signs off; that’s normally another 7–10 business days. So we’re looking at ~3–4 weeks total if everything moves smoothly.

Regarding credits: to avoid interruption we’d need at least +500k tokens to get through procurement (covers ~2 weeks at current burn, plus buffer for initial scale). If you can approve that, we’ll proceed with the final integration steps this week.

PO: I’ll have Procurement issue a PO once we confirm the credit extension and short-term rate.

Appreciate you looping folks in.

—
Alice Rivera
Head of Product, Clinical AI | Acme Health
alice.rivera@acmehealth.com

Attachment: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Rivera <alice.rivera@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate check-in

Thanks Alice — that helps. I can start the approval process for a 500k token top-up. Per our credit policy I need sign-off from my manager for amounts >200k; looping Rishi to approve a one-time extension.

If approved we’ll:
- Add 500k tokens to your pilot account immediately (no billing until pilot conversion).
- Lock a short-term rate for the extension period: our proposed bridge rate is $950/1M tokens for up to 30 days (this is a short-term courtesy rate while procurement completes).

I’ve attached a short proposal / statement of work for the extension (proposal_ACME_pilot_extension.pdf) that Procurement can use to expedite the PO. If Procurement can issue a PO this week, we’ll apply the credits and refund/discount appropriately on conversion.

Rishi — can you confirm approval for the 500k credit top-up and the bridge rate?

-Marissa

Attachment: proposal_ACME_pilot_extension.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Alice Rivera <alice.rivera@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-16T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate check-in

Approved — we’ll provision a one-time 500,000 token credit for Acme Health to cover the procurement gap. A few notes on economics and follow-up: 

- One-time credit: 500,000 tokens applied immediately to the pilot account.
- Short-term bridge rate: approve $900/1M tokens for up to 30 days while Procurement completes the PO (this is below list but scoped to this bridge window).
- Post-trial pricing: we’ll work with Marissa to present a reserved-capacity recommendation once we see 2–4 weeks of scaled usage. Given Acme’s projected 2.1M/month, we’ll model a reserved commit vs on-demand comparison in the next proposal (I’ll review unit economics and expected savings).

Marissa — please apply the credits and confirm once they’re live. Ethan — can your team monitor the token burn and flag any unexpected spikes?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: none

From: Alice Rivera <alice.rivera@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-17T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate check-in

This is great — thank you, Rishi and Marissa. Please proceed with the 500k token top-up. Procurement will issue a PO once we receive the proposal doc and the DocuSign link for the short-term engagement. PO number (for reference): ACME-PO-78921 — I’ve attached the PO draft.

Ethan — we’ll need your team to validate inference latency on the new data slice next week; can you confirm availability?

I’ll wait for the DocuSign link and confirmation that the credits are live.

Best,
Alice

Attachment: acme_po_78921.pdf

From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Rivera <alice.rivera@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-17T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate check-in

On it — our infra team will run a latency and throughput check Wednesday morning and report back.

-Ethan
Engineer, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
